tools.name: aeep_list_capabilities
tools.description: List semantic capabilities and their available CLI, Python, HTTP, MCP, or host executors before choosing an action.

tools.name: aeep_route_action
tools.description: Profile and rank feasible execution routes for an agent action without executing it. Returns estimates, hard-constraint rejections, score components, and the selected route.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

tools.name: aeep_execute_action
tools.description: Route and execute an agent action within the operator-configured server approval ceiling. AEEP applies hard constraints first, then balances cost, latency, compute pressure, reliability, quality, and risk. Returns execution receipts.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

dry_run.description: Return the route decision without invoking the executor.

tools.name: aeep_record_outcome
tools.description: Report the observed result of a browser, computer-use, model, or other host-delegated route so future decisions learn its actual cost, latency, compute use, and reliability.

tools.name: aeep_request_quotes
tools.description: Request expiring execution quotes for compatible routes without accepting or paying for one. Quote acceptance and financial approval remain operator-only.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

tools.name: aeep_get_metrics
tools.description: Read private aggregate savings, substitutions, resource use, and subscription capacity conserved from local AEEP history.
